Ready to take your career global?
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a hands-on Design Lead to drive elegant, simple designs that enable rapid integrations with Alternative Payment Method (APM) provider APIs and deliver end-to-end capabilities for new non-card payment products.
 What You'll Own
 You will lead design within a cross-functional team, translating business needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable Java microservices and integration flows, optimizing for speed-to-integration, product agility, and operational excellence.
Own team-level design
Define clear, minimal, and stable service and integration boundaries to onboard new APM providers quickly.
Lead designs for merchant-facing solutions; ensure backward-compatible evolution and alignment with architectural rails.
Choose simple, proven patterns over complexity; document concise HLD and LLD focusing on essential decisions and trade-offs.
 Enable rapid APM integrations
Create reusable integration templates and accelerators for APM onboarding (authentication, routing, mapping, error handling, webhooks and notifications).
Standardize provider payload mapping and transformations (JOLT, JEXL) and govern design patterns for consistency across APMs.
Embed resilience patterns and idempotency for retries, timeouts, and callback handling.
 Accelerate delivery and continuous improvement
Remove bottlenecks in the delivery flow; measure and improve lead time for changes, deployment frequency, and change failure rate.
Facilitate and initiate experiments, and enable engineering continuous improvement; codify learnings into standards, templates, and playbooks.
 Build quality and automation in
Establish a pragmatic test strategy: unit (JUnit 5 and 6), mutation (PIT), containerized integration, contract (Pact), acceptance (Cucumber, WireMock), and performance (JMeter).
Drive CI/CD excellence, using immutable stage-to-production image promotion and quality gates.
Leverage GitHub, Dependabot, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate safe changes and reduce toil; codify standards via reusable pipelines and PR templates.
 Operability by design
Instrument services with OpenTelemetry; deliver actionable Splunk dashboards and xMatters alerts aligned to SLOs and SLIs.
Optimize deployments (readiness, liveness, autoscaling, resource limits) and ensure smooth rollouts and quick rollback paths.
 Cross-functional leadership
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, SRE/Platform, Security, Compliance, and Commercial/Partner teams to shape roadmaps and integration plans.
Lead design and code reviews; mentor engineers on design thinking, clean code, and refactoring; support knowledge transfer across locations.
 What You'll Bring
8 to 12 years of software engineering experience with 2 to 4 years in a team, tech lead, or design lead role;
Strong Java and Spring Boot expertise; proven delivery of microservices and third-party API integrations in production;
Experience integrating with provider APIs, preferably payments/APMs, including authentication flows, webhooks, and error models;
Hands-on CI/CD, DevOps, and containerization (Kubernetes and OpenShift); solid grasp of secure coding and OWASP practices;
Excellent collaboration and communication skills; experience working in cross-functional teams and Agile environments;
Mindset focused on accelerating delivery and leading and supporting continuous improvement of engineering.
 About The Team
 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
 What makes a Globalpayer?
 Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.
